summary_en: Image Magic completed acquisition of all shares of Hasegawa Bijutsu Inc. through stock acquisition and simplified stock exchange. Hasegawa Bijutsu became a 100% subsidiary effective October 1, 2026. The acquisition impact on FY2026 results is expected to be minimal, with only balance sheet consolidation in Q4.
title_en: Notification of Completion of Full Subsidiary Status of Hasegawa Bijutsu Inc. through Stock Acquisition and Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
Image Magic announced the completion of the full acquisition of Hasegawa Bijutsu Inc. through a two-step process: first acquiring a portion of Hasegawa Bijutsu's issued shares, then executing a simplified stock exchange whereby Image Magic became the parent company and Hasegawa Bijutsu became the subsidiary. As of October 1, 2026, Hasegawa Bijutsu is now a 100% subsidiary of Image Magic. Hasegawa Bijutsu engages in silk-screen printing operations and is based in Eihei-cho, Yoshida District, Fukui Prefecture.

The completion follows the September 18, 2026 announcement outlining the acquisition and exchange plan. Both the stock acquisition and stock exchange have become effective as of October 1, 2026. For accounting purposes, only the balance sheet will be consolidated in Q4 of fiscal 2026, and the company expects the acquisition to have minimal impact on full-year results for the period ending December 2026. The company will make further disclosures if material developments arise.
